DISCOVERY 612, PLAINTIFF'S MOTION TO COMPEL FURTHER RESPONSES TO FIRST DEMAND FOR PRODUCTION OF DOCUMENTS IS GRANTED IN PART AND DENIED IN PART. AS TO ANY DOCUMENTS SUBJECT TO A CLAIM OF PRIVILEGE, THEY SHALL BE IDENTIFIED WITH PARTICULARITY. THE RELEVANT TIME IS PROPERLY LIMITED TO THE DATE PLAINTIFF APPLIED FOR AND/OR OBTAINED INSURANCE SEPARATELY FROM HER PARENTS. AS TO DOCUMENTS FOR WHICH CONFIDENTIALITY IS CLAIMED, THE DOCUMENTS SHALL BE PRODUCED SUBJECT TO AN ORDER MAINTAINING THEM IN CONFIDENCE AND LIMITED IN USE TO THIS LITIGATION. THE MOTION IS GRANTED AS TO NOS. 1, 2, AND 10. THE OBJECTIONS ARE OVERRULED AND ORDERED STRICKEN. RESPOND FURTHER AND PRODUCE. ANY DOCUMENTS WITHHELD PURSUANT TO PRIVILEGE SHALL BE IDENTIFIED WITH PARTICULARITY. THE MOTION IS GRANTED AS TO NOS. 4-6, 8, 11-16, 17-19, 20, 22, 23, 26, AND 29 THE MOTION IS DENIED AS TO NOS. 27, 28, 30, 31, 32, AND 33 AS THEY ARE IRRELEVANT. THE MOTION IS DENIED AS TO NOS. 34 AND 35 AS THEY ARE OVERLY BROAD. FURTHER RESPONSES SHALL BE MADE WITHIN 15 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. ALL REQUESTS FOR SANCTIONS ARE DENIED. DEFENDANT'S EVIDENTIARY OBJECTIONS ARE OVERRULED. MODIFICATION: THE MOTION IS DENIED AS TO #7. THE MOTION IS GRANTED AS TO NOS. 4-6, 8, 11-16, 17-19, 20, 22, 23, 26, AND 29. COMMISSIONER EVERETT A. HEWLETT, JR. MATTER NOT REPORTED.
